title: The Michelin Guide for CROPS
description: We are expanding the scope of the expertise and tooling we have built over the years, from assessing L2s and bridges to assessing all kinds of onchain projects, with the goal of providing Ethereum users with a “Michelin Guide” to CROPS-y protocols. We will explain what it takes to perform these assessments at scale, describe the tooling improvements we are making, and announce the initial list of projects. The ultimate goal is for wallets and frontends to integrate these certifications and for protocols to compete to earn them, much like restaurants compete for Michelin stars.
